observation.command:
hostname -I | awk '{print $1}' > /tmp/ip.txt; echo "ip=$(cat /tmp/ip.txt)"
# RabbitMQ needs a stable hostname mapping; add to /etc/hosts
HOST=$(hostname)
echo "127.0.0.1 $HOST" >> /etc/hosts
# Start RabbitMQ as root->rabbitmq user
export RABBITMQ_NODENAME=rabbit@localhost RABBITMQ_NODE_IP_ADDRESS=127.0.0.1 RABBITMQ_CTL_EPMD_ADDRESS=127.0.0.1
nohup rabbitmq-server > /tmp/rabbitmq.log 2>&1 &
echo "rabbitmq starting PID $!"
sleep 25
rabbitmqctl status 2>&1 | head -15 || tail -15 /tmp/rabbitmq.log
